'''Tekwan''' is a soup dish originating from the Indonesian region of [[Palembang]]. The dish contains small fish cakes made of local [[Musi River (Indonesia)|Musi river]] fish similar to [[pempek]], and is served with savory [[Shrimp and prawn as food|shrimp]] [[broth]], [[rice vermicelli]], [[Edible mushrooms|mushrooms]], and sliced [[jicama]], sprinkled with sliced fresh [[celery]], [[scallion|scallions]], and fried [[shallot|shallots]].<ref>{{cite book | last=Von Holzen | first=H. | last2=Ltd | first2=M.C.I.P. | title=A New Approach to Indonesian Cooking | publisher=Marshall Cavendish | year=2014 | isbn=978-981-4634-95-3 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=pRuiBQAAQBAJ&pg=PA90 |page=90| access-date=January 29, 2015}}</ref>
